notes.title: Grimmwood: They Come at Night going offline! Thank you all for supporting us!
notes.content:
Dear Grimmwood community

Almost one year ago, our game “[b]Grimmwood: They Come at Night[/b]” launched on Steam and we had players from all over the world joining us for an exciting and challenging adventure. Brave men a women that joined forces and worked together towards a common goal, to defend their village from a dark evil that was lurking in the mystical forest just outside their home.

Today is a sad day for us at Headup and Big Moustache Games as we have to inform you that Grimmwood can no longer be bought on Steam or any other store and the game servers will now be deactivated.

We really wish that there was a way for the game to continue but after going through all possible scenarios we see no other option.

We want to thank all of you for your support throughout the past year.

Thank you and kind regards

Headup & Big Moustache Games

notes.title: The game's free for 3 more days - spread the good word!
notes.content:
Hi there, [b]Fellow Villagers[/b],

The game's free to play for just a 3 more days! 

You can help the cause immensely by just spreading the word. For that we'll be forever in debt to you, honestly. Now is the time!

Also, anyone who has played the game for free will be able to buy it at 50% discount till February 4th. So please tell your friends and ANYONE how could be interested. Anywhere - forums, chats, messengers. [b] MAKE SOME NOISE :)[/b]

[b]Thank you from the bottoms of our hearts![/b] - The Grimm Team

Happy Halloween Horror: Join the "Pumpkin Hunt" in the dark forests of Grimmwood!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33237070/98ff65ccfe5601c2f931922ae06c33697c5fd5d4.jpg[/img]

Let's talk about... Pumpkins! What would become of Halloween if not for our humble, orange friend - no Jack O'Lanterns, no pumpkin pie, no headless rider, no... [b]Halloween[/b]!

That's why the "[b]Pumpkin Hunt[/b]" is available until Nov 5th! Make sure to collect as many pumpkins as possible as you not only can unlock new Steam achievements, but will also refresh your precious stamina points. They can be found at all points of interest or dropped as loot from killed monsters (god knows what they were going to do with them...).

[b]Here’s a list with the key update features:[/b]

[b]1. A new “Pumpkin” item[/b]
- Will be available only during the Halloween Event;
- Can be used as food and the Stamina Points it gives won’t affect your Hunger levels (meaning that all SP’s you gain by eating Pumpkins will further extend the SP amount available daily.);
- Will be very light in terms of weight (will weigh roughly as much as any Herb item);
- Can be found in any Point of Interest and will drop from killed Monsters.

[b]2. Three new achievements[/b]
- “Pumpkin Retriever”
- “Pumpkin Hunter”
- “Pumpkin Master”
Note: All three can be achieved by eating Pumpkins, which means that you’ll only have the week of the Halloween Event to get those.

[b]3. A new “Bulk Crafting” functionality:[/b]
- Allows you to craft more than one item simultaneously;
- Will contain a detailed report on the number of the successful and the failed attempts, the SP’s spent, the potential change in the durability of the tolls used.

[b]4. A new “Root Porridge” recipe:[/b]
- Made out of Roots;
- Makes the cooked roots 100% safe for eating.

[b]5. Numerous bug fixes, optimizations and improvements.[/b]

notes.title: Currently experiencing gameplay lag
notes.content:
There’s a noticeable, although relatively light gameplay lag at the moment. Our servers are performing optimally (no load peaks, connectivity drops, etc.), and also no updates have been made the last 48 hours. Seems like the problem is originates outside of our own “environment”. Nevertheless, we’re investigating as we write this. 

We’ll keep you posted if the problem persists.

Apologies for the inconvenience!

notes.title: The Supporter Pack DLC is available
notes.content:
Hey there guys,

Our Supporter Pack is finally available at a price that we believe is more than affordable :) It is offered as DLC and contains:
- The full original soundtrack of the game in high quality (WAV format);
- The Grimmwood art book with 50+ pages of game images and concepts (including never before published materials), in PDF format.

Our deepest gratitude to anyone who decides to support Grimmwood by buying the Supporter Pack!

notes.title: Server restart 6pm CET (9am PDT), due to game update
Night Attack Issues, August 13th
notes.content:
There were problems in the last Night Attack which caused (for some Villages) skipping a game day ahead. The probable cause for that are the communication issues with the server hosting services the game uses. 

We are investigating the reasons behind that, as I write this. In the meantime - the game is fully playable with no other major issues detected at the moment.

We apologize to everyone, doing our absolute best to prevent this from happening ever again. 

Thank you for your understanding!
